---
# `title` would render Quarto's article title block above the section; the
# page draws its own heading, so only the meta description and tab title are
# set here (the same pattern as index.qmd).
description: "That page doesn't exist or has moved. Search the site, or jump to projects, publications, and posts."
pagetitle: "Page Not Found | Noah Weidig"
page-layout: custom
toc: false
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script src="/assets/notfound.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<section id="notfound" class="nw-section nw-page-band">
  <div class="nw-hero-dots" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="nw-section-inner">
    <p class="nw-kicker">Error 404</p>
    <h1 class="nw-title">That page doesn't exist</h1>
    <p class="nw-subtitle">The link may be out of date, or the address slightly off. Search the site for what you were after, or pick a section below.</p>
    <!-- The search button stays hidden until assets/notfound.js finds the
         navbar's overlay-search trigger to forward the click to: with no JS,
         or on a build without site search, it never appears as a dead control. -->
    <div class="nw-btns">
      <button type="button" class="nw-btn nw-btn-primary" data-nw-404-search hidden>
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10" cy="10" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-6 -6"/></svg>
        Search the site
      </button>
      <a class="nw-btn nw-btn-ghost" href="/">Go home</a>
    </div>
    <!-- The cards are fallbacks: scripts/build-404.ts rebuilds them at render
         time from the navbar in _quarto.yml, so the list can't go stale when a
         section is added, renamed or removed. -->
    <div class="nw-start-grid nw-404-grid" data-nw-404-destinations>
      <a class="nw-start-card" href="/projects/">
        <h2>Projects</h2>
        <p>Geospatial analysis, R packages, and data tools.</p>
        <span class="nw-start-link">Go to this section →</span>
      </a>
      <a class="nw-start-card" href="/publications/">
        <h2>Publications</h2>
        <p>Papers, presentations, and media coverage.</p>
        <span class="nw-start-link">Go to this section →</span>
      </a>
      <a class="nw-start-card" href="/blog/">
        <h2>Blog</h2>
        <p>Notes on R, spatial data, and working reproducibly.</p>
        <span class="nw-start-link">Go to this section →</span>
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
